question: "Meri LiFE" (My life) app was launched in May 2023 by union minister Shri Bhupender Yadav. Which ministry does he belong?

options.text: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shri Bhupender Yadav** is the Union Minister for the **Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change**.
 
• The **"Meri LiFE" (My Life) app** was launched in May 2023 by him to promote sustainable living and environmental conservation.
 
• The Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change is responsible for planning, promoting, coordinating, and overseeing the implementation of environmental and forestry policies and programs in India.
 
• This ministry works on various initiatives to combat climate change, protect wildlife, and preserve forests and biodiversity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change** plays a crucial role in formulating and enforcing environmental regulations and guidelines.
 
• It also engages in international cooperation on environmental issues and represents India in global environmental forums.
 
• The ministry's initiatives include programs for afforestation, pollution control, and wildlife protection, among others.
 
• Shri Bhupender Yadav has been actively involved in promoting environmental awareness and sustainable practices through various campaigns and initiatives.
